persona: University student or new graduate preparing first internship/graduate applications from academic projects, volunteering and limited work experience

reviewer_provenance.configuration_evidence: Root confirmed the spawn_agent invocation used model=gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning_effort=high, fork_turns=none.
reviewer_provenance.qualification: Configuration provenance only; no separate provider/runtime identity introspection was available.
reviewer_provenance.independence: Did not read prior audit scores, reports, improvement targets or parent conversations. Scores were formed independently.

scope.method: Read-only source inspection, public browser UI inspection, ephemeral synthetic guest CV check, guest PDF download/text extraction, 390x844 responsive screenshot, and navigation recovery. No account creation, server saves, paid provider runs, mail actions, applications, connections or scheduling mutations.
scope.deployed_commit: Not independently verified. Public copy and the observed CV behavior agree with inspected source paths; this does not prove production runs the exact source commit.
scope.tests: No unit-test totals used as customer-experience evidence; no installation or runtime/code changes.

rubric: 1-100 persona judgment: 1=unusable/untrustworthy, 25=major unmet needs, 50=partial useful experience with substantial effort or uncertainty, 75=useful coherent experience with material gaps, 100=exceptionally complete and directly demonstrated. Unknown capabilities are not asserted to work or to be broken. Willingness-to-pay is a reviewer inference, not purchase research.

scores.reason: Useful first-application evidence review and free export for students with an existing CV. It does not guide a blank-CV student through constructing education/project sections, and the wider repeated-search benefit is not live-demonstrated.

Six clearly labelled guest steps, academic guidance and no card/account requirement. Primary Job Loop CTA leads to sign-in; reusable facts require a lengthy profile and per-claim classification/confirmation.

Readable desktop layout, named fields, skip link, focused stage headings and mobile reflow observed. Evidence produces a very long review; PDF frame was blank in this browser. Keyboard-only, screen-reader, contrast and device PDF interoperability were not comprehensively tested.

Literal supporting passages and academic labels remain visible; approval and confidentiality checks precede export. Actual downloaded PDF is one A4 page with searchable fixture text. Completed coursework was incorrectly framed as potentially unfinished, and visual PDF quality remains unverified.

Guest supplies the entire vacancy. Source has limited configurable employer boards, title/location overlap and optional search; graduate eligibility, sponsorship and closing conditions still need human review. No live student shortlist or real coverage was demonstrated.

Local comparison/export work, while source supports claim reuse, bounded preparation and opt-in scheduling. First setup, full vacancy capture, claim fields, factual corrections and each packet approval impose considerable effort. Live cloud, scheduler and inbox readiness are unknown.

Source implements honest self-reported stages, notes, follow-up dates, due cards and actor/time history. First guest application offers optional saving, with two account workspaces to understand. Deadline is detected as a question rather than captured into an actionable dated record in the tested guest path.

Guest analysis, approval, download and in-app draft recovery succeeded; recovery correctly cleared approval. One-page preference reset to two pages after returning through generic /check, and embedded PDF display failed in this environment. Account failures, expired sessions and recurring recovery were source-inspected, not exercised.

Local guest processing, separate save and temporary-storage consent, disclosed Gmail/AI boundaries, and source erasure/withdrawal controls are good. Account-wide deletion requires a private request; separate records remain. Backend isolation, actual retention and full erasure completion were not tested.

Free check is worth trying. I would hesitate at proposed $15/$29 monthly student spending until relevant graduate jobs, reliable PDF review and measurable second-application savings are demonstrated. This is persona inference; checkout is unavailable and no payment was attempted.

journey.detail: Pasted synthetic Alex Sample BSc/project/volunteering CV. Student guidance explicitly admits coursework without employment. Requires existing source text; no blank academic CV wizard observed.

Pasted synthetic graduate-data-analyst description. Ten sentence/list requirements were extracted, including the fixture-only introductory sentence and deadline. One direct wording finding and nine manual-review findings resulted.

One-page PDF preflight, exact-preview link, approval controls and completed download observed. PDF.js independently extracted one A4 page with all supplied fixture facts. IAB embedded PDF frame was blank on desktop and mobile; typography/clipping were not visually verified.
Guest approval enabled free PDF/DOCX/TXT and separate evidence-report controls. PDF download completed. No employer submission happened; the user must submit independently.

Source saves reusable confirmed/shareable claims and reuses current packets; changed facts invalidate affected approvals. No signed-in second application was run. Guest route recovery kept the CV but reset page preference and required reapproval.

Application status, follow-up date, notes, due cards and activity history are implemented in Job Loop. A changed status requires self-attestation; document preparation is not submission. No account tracker update was made.

Opt-in daily/weekdays/weekly rules preparation, timezone/time, next-run state, pause/cancel and run history exist. UI depends on scheduler readiness, cleared claims and a ten-account pilot. Actual scheduler deployment and execution were not observed.

key_evidence.finding: Six-step account-free academic CV journey, local-analysis disclosures, approval controls and successful PDF download.

Fixture passage 'Built an Excel dashboard for a university coursework project using a synthetic dataset of 200 orders.' receives 'may describe something unfinished, expired or not held' for Excel/dashboard findings. PENDING regex includes coursework; matching uncertain chunks trigger conflict. Academic context is not itself evidence of non-completion.

key_evidence.source: CV-Graduate data analyst.pdf; extracted using existing pdfjs-dist
key_evidence.finding: One 595.28x841.89-point page; searchable text preserves expected June 2027, academic project, exact 200 orders, contribution and volunteering. Evidence warnings are absent from the exported CV. No visual rendering assessment claimed.
PDF iframe blank in this IAB environment despite successful generation. Alternate exact-preview link exists. Scope is browser-specific, not a claim all customers have a broken PDF.

Returning through generic /check restored academic source and final text and cleared approval, but Maximum PDF length changed from One page to Two pages; student guidance no longer appeared without audience parameter.

Per-claim context, source quote, wording, result status and two confirmations precede reuse. Manual tracking, activity, source coverage and rules-only recurring UI are implemented. Successful production account behavior unverified.

Default employer feeds are Careem, GoCardless and Duolingo; environment can replace these. Role/location filtering and overlap heuristic exist. Web snippets remain unverified and held pending full confirmed vacancy. Actual production boards and searches are unknown.

Pilot is free, first ten accounts, checkout disabled; $15 Focus/$29 Job Loop are explicitly future proposals. Privacy distinguishes guest/account/Job Loop records and optional providers. Erasing Job Loop does not erase sign-in account or separate workspace records.

top_5_actions.action: Correct academic evidence uncertainty and reduce irrelevant review findings.
top_5_actions.why: Students are invited to use coursework, yet completed coursework is framed as potentially unfinished and administrative vacancy sentences count as requirements.
acceptance_criteria: In at least 30 independently labelled student fixtures, completed coursework is never flagged pending solely because of coursework/student context.
Expected degrees, genuinely unfinished projects and expired credentials remain visibly unresolved in every relevant control fixture.
Administrative title/fixture-introduction/deadline text is separated from capability findings; at least 90% of extracted capability findings are relevant in a labelled sample.
Five novice students can explain the difference between a wording match and qualification verification after the evidence screen.

top_5_actions.action: Provide a guided first academic CV and progressively reveal reusable-claim controls.
top_5_actions.why: A student with no CV must already know how to structure their record; full claim-editor terminology adds friction before demonstrated value.
acceptance_criteria: At least 8 of 10 novice students starting without a CV create an accurate education/project/activities CV and first reviewed preview within 10 minutes without assistance.
The flow asks for individual contribution, context and completion status, preserving academic labels and never inventing employment or results.
Reusable facts retain inspectable source passages and separate factual/sharing approval while optional fields appear only when needed.

top_5_actions.action: Expose real student vacancy coverage and availability before account commitment.
top_5_actions.why: A narrow configured-board/search workflow cannot yet demonstrate suitable internships and graduate roles for this persona.
acceptance_criteria: A read-only availability view lists active discovery sources, latest completed checks, pilot capacity and scheduler readiness without claiming unconnected features.

Evaluate at least 50 graduate/internship postings across three target regions; report relevance precision, stale/closed rate and source coverage, with at least 80% of recommended titles meeting the stated career-stage filter.

Each shortlist item shows official source, checked time and explicit unknowns for eligibility, sponsorship, pay and closing date; all unverified snippets require source completion before usable output.

top_5_actions.action: Make exact PDF review robust across mobile and browsers, and preserve the selected page preference.
top_5_actions.why: Generated bytes exist but an empty PDF frame impedes informed layout review; returning to the draft loses the one-page choice.
acceptance_criteria: Exact PDF pages visibly render or show an explicit supported fallback on iOS Safari, Android Chrome, desktop Chrome/Edge and the IAB at 390px width.
No silently blank preview; failure explains how to review/download the exact artifact and exposes a meaningful status.
One-page selection survives in-app navigation and authorized refresh recovery while approval still resets appropriately.
Ten representative academic CV PDFs have searchable text, preserved labels/dates and no clipped content under visual inspection.

top_5_actions.action: Unify the first-to-second application handoff, dated tracking and recurring setup around one next action.
top_5_actions.why: Students must understand guest saving, existing workspace and Job Loop; copied vacancy input and repeated approvals can outweigh reuse savings.
acceptance_criteria: In a consented synthetic account journey, a reviewed first CV can seed a career record without retyping source text; every sharing confirmation remains explicit.
At least 8 of 10 novice students complete a second role-specific packet with median active effort at least 40% lower than the first, excluding employer submission time.
A deadline can become a user-confirmed dated action with timezone; preparing/downloading never sets applied status.
A no-paid-provider pilot proves one scheduled rules run, visible actual next run/history, pause and cancellation; disabled services and full pilot capacity are disclosed before setup.

gaps_and_limits: No production authenticated journey, first/second saved packet, tracker save, scheduler occurrence, inbox connection, Gmail draft or support/erasure request was executed.
No live employer shortlist, open-posting confirmation, external model quality, paid-search results or deployment configuration was established.
Only a pasted English text fixture was exercised. Uploaded PDF/DOCX extraction, scanned PDF handling, multilingual CVs, long CVs and complex typography were not tested.
A downloaded PDF was text-extracted, but its visual layout was not rendered by the IAB; DOCX/TXT downloads were available but not downloaded or inspected.
Mobile observation was responsive viewport simulation, not a physical-device test or comprehensive accessibility certification.
Privacy disclosures and control implementation were inspected; actual network payload isolation, production row-level access, retention jobs and account-wide erasure were not independently verified.
Willingness-to-pay and expected time savings are reviewer judgments/proposed validation metrics, not measured market demand or customer outcomes.
Initial web fetch and initial browser creation timed out, but the retry loaded normally; these tool events are not attributed to product downtime.
customer_verdict: Worth trying free for a student who already has a CV and vacancy. Confidence is strongest in truthful guest preparation and export; weakest in graduate job discovery, repeated-application effort and live recurring-service availability. No hiring/interview outcome is promised or inferred.
